summary: CI-only change. The `Test JS` workflow (tests.yml) gains a pull_request `paths:` filter ['**', '!docs/plans/**'], so PRs that touch only plan documents no longer run lint, unit, type, E2E or WASM jobs; push to main stays unfiltered and still runs everything after merge. The rest is test-suite work: a shared `filterCovers` helper that evaluates `paths:` lists in GitHub's last-match-wins order (used by three existing workflow-filter guards), a new guard that no test file names a `docs/plans/*.md` file, and removal of the EQL absorption plan from the frozen-publisher docs guard. Nothing shipped to customers changes. The material risks are low and loud: a check that reads plans without naming one literally would go red on main after a plan-only merge, and the EQL plan, still cited by release-gate output, loses its drift guard. Tests for the new behaviour exist but were not run here.

behaviour_changes.description: tests.yml (`Test JS`) no longer triggers on pull requests whose changed files are all under docs/plans/. Any PR touching at least one other path still runs it. push to main remains unfiltered.

Three workflow-filter guards (wasm build-input cache-key parity, auth-binding filter coverage, workflow trigger-comment scope) now evaluate `paths:` lists with ordered negation via `filterCovers` instead of `paths.some(...)`. tests.yml moves from 'unfiltered' to 'filtered' in these guards and is treated as covering everything except docs/plans.

New invariant guard: no tracked test file (\_\_tests\_\_, *.test.*, e2e/) may contain a literal `docs/plans/<name>.md` path. It is text-based and does not see paths built at run time or directory walks.

frozen-publisher-docs.test.mjs no longer checks docs/plans/2026-08-13-eql-monorepo-absorption.md for the `@cipherstash/eql` freeze instruction, foreign-publish claims or live gate-verdict claims; AGENTS.md prose updated to match.

failure_scenarios.title: A check that reads plan documents goes red on main after a plan-only PR merges unchecked
failure_scenarios.trigger: A PR edits only docs/plans/ while some test, lint script or Biome rule run by tests.yml reads plan content without naming a literal docs/plans/*.md path (directory walk, glob, constructed path, or a non-test script).
failure_scenarios.mechanism: tests.yml no longer runs on the PR, so the breaking content merges; the unfiltered push-to-main run then fails. The new guard only greps test files for a literal plan filename, and by its own comment does not see paths built at run time or scripts outside the test globs.
failure_scenarios.consequence: main turns red until a follow-up fix; unrelated PRs may see confusing failures. Loud and easily reverted; no shipped artefact affected.

existing_verification.description: plan-docs-unread-by-tests.test.mjs fails if a test file names a plan file, with a self-check that the scan finds a known match.
push to main is unfiltered, so every merge still runs the full Test JS suite.

missing_verification: No check covers non-test scripts run by tests.yml (release-gate, lint:* scripts, Biome) or runtime-built plan paths. Scans read here (go-module-path, lint-no-dead-package-paths) exclude docs/plans, but this was a sampled read, not exhaustive.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Accept; main's unfiltered push run catches it. Optionally widen the guard's pathspec to scripts/*.mjs or note the limitation in AGENTS.md.

failure_scenarios.title: EQL absorption plan drifts unguarded while release tooling still points operators to it
failure_scenarios.trigger: A later edit to docs/plans/2026-08-13-eql-monorepo-absorption.md reintroduces a freeze instruction, a foreign-publish claim or a live gate verdict, or a package is frozen again.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: The plan was removed from DOCS, so the iff check against FROZEN_PUBLISHERS and the LIVE_VERDICT_CLAIMS check no longer read it. release-gate.mjs's frozen-package failure output and release.yml's EQL summary still direct readers to that plan.
failure_scenarios.consequence: An agent or maintainer following the release-gate output could act on stale freeze/publish guidance. FROZEN_PUBLISHERS is empty at head, so the release-gate message that names the plan does not fire today.

existing_verification.description: AGENTS.md and SECURITY.md remain in DOCS and are still held to the map.

missing_verification: Nothing checks the plan's text any more; the co-change history shows the guard and the plan usually changed together.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Reviewer to confirm the plan is purely historical, or repoint the release-gate.mjs / release.yml references at a guarded document.

failure_scenarios.title: Plan-only PRs stall if Test JS checks are or become required
failure_scenarios.trigger: A branch ruleset requires any Test JS job (e.g. 'Lint (Biome)', 'Run Tests (Node …)') as a status check.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: GitHub does not report a status for a workflow skipped by a paths filter, so a required check stays 'Expected' and blocks merge of plan-only PRs.
failure_scenarios.consequence: Plan-only PRs cannot merge without an admin bypass. Visible, no data or artefact impact.
missing_verification: Live branch protection / ruleset configuration was not available; only the repo's comment that no required_status_checks rule exists was read.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Confirm no Test JS job is a required check before merge; if one becomes required, add an always-reporting aggregator job as test-eql.yml does.
